verdict.rationale: Cerebras exposes everything the console Playground does through its documented API: model calls, tool calling, parameter tuning and export-to-code. The API also covers streaming, structured outputs, batch, and a separate Dedicated Inference management API with its own OpenAPI spec for uploading, versioning and deploying models. However, the console's other functions (projects, API keys, usage, billing, team access) have no documented API equivalent in the evidence, so full UI-to-API parity is unproven. missing for 10: API for API-key/project management, programmatic usage and billing access, team/access management API, independent confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
